_schema.purpose: DATA CONTRACT for search.js -- a small static search index over the RAG Guide core sections. Stub-level fixture for the prototype.
_schema.shape: Top-level { items: [{ title, href, section, body }] }. search.js also accepts a bare top-level array. Each item: title (display + heading-weighted match), href (in-page anchor or relative page path), section (section-id label shown after a result), body (short plain-text excerpt scored on substring match).
rules: one item per indexable core section; keep body to ~1-2 sentences
href is an in-page anchor (#slug) on the landing page or a relative path
ASCII punctuation only; RU body text mirrors the ported prose
underscore-prefixed keys (like _schema) are metadata and MUST be skipped by consumers

items.title: Obzor: RAG za 4 shaga
items.body: RAG na verhnem urovne -- konvejer iz chetyreh shagov: ingest plus chunking, embedding, store plus retrieve, generate. Karta vsego recepta; ostalnoe -- drill-down vnutr ee uzlov.

items.title: Chunking: rezhem dokument na chunki
items.body: Dokument rezhut na chunki retrieval-razmera. Splitter reshaet gde rezat, overlap sohranyaet smysl na granice, metadata krepit istochnik i poziciyu. Razmer chunka i overlap -- kompromiss, ne konstanta.

items.title: Embedding: chunk prevrashchaem v vektor
items.body: Kazhdyj chunk prevrashchaem v vektor fiksirovannoj dliny dim, gde blizost vektorov otrazhaet blizost smysla. Pohozhest izmeryayut geometricheski, chashche cosine similarity.
